name: Jar of healing tonic
description: A thin tonic in a thinner jar. Drink it before the jar gets ideas of its own.
notes: A breakable jar holding a mild healing tonic (mw-ju8.4): drinking restores 15 health. Dropped or thrown hard, the jar breaks (pottery profile), emits breakableBroken and the tonic is lost. Base value 10 sits in the economy jar band (4-12).
